name: vinayagamoorthy-jothidam-app
description: Repo-root build/deploy orchestration for the Cloudflare Workers static-assets deployment. The React/Vite frontend lives in vinayagamoorthy-web/; wrangler.jsonc points at vinayagamoorthy-web/dist.

scripts.build: npm --prefix vinayagamoorthy-web ci && npm --prefix vinayagamoorthy-web run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy
